sections.h2: The cess buys about 1,700 km of highway a year at average project cost

sections.h2: Each electric vehicle avoids the road cess its fuel-burning twin pays

chart.title: Road cess per vehicle a year runs from ₹1,000 for a two-wheeler to ₹34,286 for a bus
chart.sub: Road cess a fuel vehicle pays each year, in ₹, which its electric version avoids.
chart.source: This blog's estimates; Vahan; ICCT; UrbanEmissions.

sections.means: The post estimates each electric vehicle avoids the road cess that its petrol or diesel twin pays every year.

sections.h2: National highway tolls more than doubled in four years, now above the road cess

chart.title: Tolls rose from ₹33,929 crore to ₹70,278 crore in four years
chart.sub: Toll collections on national highways and expressways, ₹ crore; 2022–23 not reported in the post.
chart.source: Rajya Sabha reply, July 2026, as reported in the post.

sections.means: Tolls charge per plaza crossing, so electric cars already pay them while two-wheelers do not, and tolls now outweigh the road cess.
sections.todo: Revisit satellite tolling with a privacy answer, since per-crossing tolls still charge for a point on the road, not for distance.
